hypothesis: The fixed current-season shrinkage used by exact-C ignores persistent pitcher-to-pitcher differences in year-to-year volatility. A legal row-local state-space approximation can estimate each pitcher's process variance from completed, league-centered R seasons and adapt how quickly the current-season success count overrides the latest completed-season prior.

relationship_to_prior_work.different_from_fixed_e14: Uses pitcher-specific process variance and posterior uncertainty instead of one global K.
relationship_to_prior_work.different_from_dynamic_state_catboost: The state posterior is the prediction component itself; it is not a generic residual tree around fixed E14.
relationship_to_prior_work.minimum_history: At least two completed seasons are needed for individual process variance, so 2020/2021 are intentionally not applicable source folds.

state_recipe.lifetime_counter_boundary: last official train row before target season, all game types
state_recipe.season_effect: pitcher R success rate minus same-season R league mean
state_recipe.global_process_aggregation: mean after upper winsorization at the fixed 0.90 quantile
state_recipe.global_prior: latest completed R season league mean
state_recipe.adaptive_k_formula: global_prior*(1-global_prior)/(latest sampling variance + shrunk process variance)
state_recipe.posterior: (current-season successes + adaptive_k * pitcher prior)/(current-season pitches + adaptive_k)

source_protocol.routing: blend only R rows; F remains exact-C
source_protocol.ranking: maximize minimum R gain, then minimum full gain, then mean R gain, then smaller gamma
source_protocol.on_fail: Close without reading 2024 labels for this recipe.
source_protocol.on_pass: Write a recipe lock before opening 2024. No parameter or gamma changes are permitted afterward.
